mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing slow lipid-only water exchange with rapid aquaporin exchange was most worthwhile: the matched conditions made the channel’s effect on speed distinct from the direction of net movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial inspection was the least substantive passage: it had only one available partner and automatically assembled the membrane, though it provided a useful starting picture.
